# Astris

> The modern full-stack web framework for Python. Full-stack simplicity with modern Python performance.

Astris combines FastAPI, Inertia.js (v2), Vue 3, Tailwind CSS v4, and SQLModel into a unified, high-velocity developer experience.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://astris.dev/getting-started/introduction): Overview and philosophy of Astris.
- [Installation](https://astris.dev/getting-started/installation): Prerequisites and project creation with uvx.
- [Directory Structure](https://astris.dev/getting-started/directory-structure): Domain-driven module organization.
- [Configuration](https://astris.dev/getting-started/configuration): Centralized settings and .env loading.
- [Application Kernel](https://astris.dev/architecture/kernel): Core lifecycle, middleware pipeline, and configuration.
- [Controllers & Routes](https://astris.dev/architecture/controllers): Controller routing, parameters, and Dependency Injection.
- [Module Auto-Discovery](https://astris.dev/architecture/module-discovery): Automatic controller and model scanning.
- [Inertia.js Monolith](https://astris.dev/frontend/inertia): Rendering Vue 3 single-page applications from Python.
- [Forms & Validation](https://astris.dev/frontend/forms-validation): Form handling with useForm and automatic error flashing.
- [Database & SQLModel](https://astris.dev/database/models): Declarative tables, DTO schemas, and queries.
- [Schema Migrations](https://astris.dev/database/migrations): Alembic migration workflows with Orbit CLI.
- [Authentication](https://astris.dev/security/authentication): Signed session cookies and Argon2id password hashing.
- [CSRF Protection](https://astris.dev/security/csrf): Automated XSRF token handling.
- [Orbit CLI](https://astris.dev/cli/orbit): Developer CLI for scaffolding, migrations, and serving.
- [Production & Docker](https://astris.dev/deployment/production): Multi-stage Docker deployment and orbit serve --prod.

## AI Agent Playbook

- [Astris for Agents](https://astris.dev/for/agents): Step-by-step setup guide and code conventions for AI coding agents.
